# Proxenos

> A free, open-source agent that keeps your own records private on your computer and drafts the next step for you. Built first for people getting through the health care system. Python (src/proxenos) and a local Next.js page (web/). MIT.

Proxenos gathers a person's messages, email, calendar, notes and documents into a private vault on their own computer, keeps a written model of who they are, and runs small agents ("clones") over it: tasks from conversations, where health care stands, replies and emails drafted in the person's own voice, a research feed, advice, a map of people, a searchable memory, and project work done on a branch for the person to accept. It drafts; the person sends. It runs on an open model through Ollama, so nothing has to leave the computer.

## Start here

- [README](https://github.com/mindemory/proxenos/blob/main/README.md): what it is, pictures, privacy, quick start, sources and commands
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/mindemory/proxenos/blob/main/AGENTS.md): the repo map, checks and rules for changing it
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/mindemory/proxenos/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): how to help, good first contributions, adding a source or a clone

- [Proxenos for everyone](https://github.com/mindemory/proxenos/blob/main/docs/everyone.md): one download, signing in instead of configuring, a privacy screen

- [Roadmap](https://github.com/mindemory/proxenos/blob/main/docs/roadmap.md): from drafting, to acting on approval, to acting within rules
- [Voice model](https://github.com/mindemory/proxenos/blob/main/docs/voice-model.md): a model trained on the person's own writing
